% Phase 8B numeric-owner lifetime and iterator contract.
% Synthetic depths test static data only; nested iteration is not S1 support.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newcount\OLCalls \newcount\OLInnerCalls \newcount\OLGroup
\def\OLFail#1{\PackageError{topology-owner-lifetime}{#1}{Owner values, lifetime and callback scope must remain exact.}}
\def\OLInt#1#2#3{\ifnum#1=#2\relax\else\OLFail{#3}\fi}
\def\OLSame#1#2#3{\ifx#1#2\else\OLFail{#3}\fi}
\def\OLField#1#2#3{%
  \expandafter\let\expandafter\OLActual\csname dte@e#1#2\endcsname
  \def\OLExpected{#3}\OLSame\OLActual\OLExpected{Wrong raw field #1/#2}}
\def\OLCleared#1#2{%
  \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e#1#2\endcsname\relax
  \else\OLFail{Stale field #1/#2}\fi}
\def\OLLoad#1{%
  \dte@flush@state\global\dte@cnt=0
  \@for\OLDepth:=#1\do{%
    \global\advance\dte@cnt by1
    \expandafter\xdef\csname dte@e\the\dte@cnt d\endcsname{\OLDepth}}}
\def\OLRow#1#2#3{\OLField{#1}{l}{#2}\OLField{#1}{a}{#3}}
\def\OLInner#1{%
  \OLInt{\currentgrouplevel}{\OLGroup}{Nested iterator added a group}%
  \advance\OLInnerCalls by1
  \edef\OLInnerTrace{\OLInnerTrace[#1]}}
\def\OLOuter#1{%
  \OLInt{\currentgrouplevel}{\OLGroup}{Iterator added a group}%
  \advance\OLCalls by1
  \edef\OLTrace{\OLTrace[#1]}%
  \def\OLTouched{visible}%
  \ifnum\OLCalls=1
    \def\OLList{999}%
    \dte@foreach@owner\OLInnerList\OLInner
  \fi}
\begin{document}
% Literal expectations use future siblings, independent of the recurrence.
% The deepest row has owners 10,9,8 in depth order, not index order.
\OLLoad{0,1,2,2,1,2,3,3,2,1,0,1}
\begingroup
  \dte@preprocess
\endgroup
\OLInt{\dte@cnt}{12}{Long model count}
\OLRow{1}{0}{}       \OLRow{2}{0}{5}
\OLRow{3}{0}{5,4}    \OLRow{4}{1}{5}
\OLRow{5}{0}{10}     \OLRow{6}{0}{10,9}
\OLRow{7}{0}{10,9,8} \OLRow{8}{1}{10,9}
\OLRow{9}{1}{10}     \OLRow{10}{1}{}
\OLRow{11}{1}{}      \OLRow{12}{1}{}
\typeout{P8B OWNER GLOBAL FIELDS PASS; rows=12}

\def\OLTouched{outside}
\begingroup
  \OLGroup=\currentgrouplevel
  \OLCalls=0 \OLInnerCalls=0
  \def\OLTrace{}\def\OLInnerTrace{}
  \def\OLList{}\def\OLInnerList{21,8}
  \dte@foreach@owner\OLList\OLOuter
  \OLInt{\OLCalls}{0}{Empty iterator invoked callback}
  \OLInt{\OLInnerCalls}{0}{Empty iterator invoked nested callback}
  \def\OLExpected{}\OLSame\OLTrace\OLExpected{Empty iterator emitted an owner}
  \def\OLExpected{outside}\OLSame\OLTouched\OLExpected{Empty iterator changed state}
  % Changing the source macro must not alter the already-started traversal.
  % A nested, different callback must not replace the outer callback.
  \def\OLList{12,3,104}
  \dte@foreach@owner\OLList\OLOuter
  \OLInt{\OLCalls}{3}{Wrong snapshot callback count}
  \OLInt{\OLInnerCalls}{2}{Wrong nested callback count}
  \def\OLExpected{[12][3][104]}\OLSame\OLTrace\OLExpected{Owner order or snapshot changed}
  \def\OLExpected{[21][8]}\OLSame\OLInnerTrace\OLExpected{Nested owner order changed}
  \def\OLExpected{999}\OLSame\OLList\OLExpected{Callback assignment hidden by grouping}
  \def\OLExpected{visible}\OLSame\OLTouched\OLExpected{Callback local effect lost}
\endgroup
\def\OLExpected{outside}\OLSame\OLTouched\OLExpected{Callback local effect leaked group}
\typeout{P8B OWNER ITERATOR PASS; empty=0; outer=3; inner=2}

% A shorter model must clear formerly nonempty high slots as well as tail slots.
\OLLoad{0,1}
\begingroup\dte@preprocess\endgroup
\OLInt{\dte@cnt}{2}{Short model count}
\OLRow{1}{1}{}\OLRow{2}{1}{}
\OLCleared{7}{a}\OLCleared{7}{l}
\OLCleared{12}{a}\OLCleared{12}{l}
\OLLoad{}
\begingroup\dte@preprocess\endgroup
\OLInt{\dte@cnt}{0}{Empty model count}
\OLCleared{1}{a}\OLCleared{1}{l}
\OLCleared{2}{a}\OLCleared{2}{l}
\OLCleared{7}{a}\OLCleared{7}{l}
\OLCleared{12}{a}\OLCleared{12}{l}
\typeout{P8B OWNER CLEANUP PASS; sizes=12,2,0}
\noindent TOPOLOGY OWNER LIFETIME PASS
\end{document}
